what: P-BANDS (2026-10-24): BCIR_TENSOR_ATTENTION_BANDS (32) lays a stored forward's probabilities out in 16-row bands with the rows in the vector lanes -- row i's probability of key j at (i/16)*16*T + j*16 + i%16 of its head's T x T region, so a band's column of 16 rows is one 64-byte line -- where the host's widest instance is AVX-512, the context a multiple of 16 and the head at most 256 wide; the stored forward computes SCORES-T's 16-row groups inside the band itself and the backward reads the bands: dV and dK by banded transposed walks, each group's probability adjoints, dots, score adjoints and dQ rows-in-lanes. The trainer's stored binary32 forward and its backward run under it (the pack and the launch plan state it). Found by BWD-NEXT's placement: the transposed products walked P across 32 concurrent row streams, the dots transposed every 16 x 16 block, and band and prefetch variants of the row walk moved nothing. Every value as it was: the row paths' hashes before == after, bands_check's cases byte for byte, the trainer's states the same digests with the bit on and off. Measured on the committed tree against the tree before it.
host: Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.30GHz, 4 vCPU (AVX-512F, AMX), 2 MiB of L2 a core, 260 MiB of L3; Linux 6.18 (transparent huge pages: madvise); clang 18.1.3 and GCC 13.3 (-std=c11 -O3 -ffp-contract=off -fno-math-errno; the level-3 overlays with GCC, as the study builds them); Python 3.11.15, NumPy 2.2.6, torch 2.13.0+cu130 (CPU); OMP_WAIT_POLICY=PASSIVE
